Hi Lori,

Per Karthik — attaching a small sample of the opt-out processing logs and the technical notes below. Note: I’ve redacted any customer-identifiable fields in the sample logs per our disclosure agreement; the full fields can be shared under an NDA if required.

Technical summary (plain English + bullets for Legal):
- Training usage: Redwood’s hosted inference platform does NOT include customer prompt/response data in downstream model fine-tuning or retraining by default. Model improvements are performed on public datasets or curated bench datasets unless a customer expressly provides opt-in for their data to be included.
- Opt-out mechanism: Customers can enable a tenant-level opt-out flag via the Console API. When opt-out=on, all prompt/response payloads are routed to a short-lived buffer for inference, then metadata-only telemetry (non-PII usage stats) is retained for 30 days by default; full prompt/response contents are purged within 72 hours.
- Dedicated/Private: For Redwood Dedicated and Private deployments, customer data remains isolated in their VPC/pool and is never mixed into any central training pipeline.
- Retention windows: default hosted retention = 72 hours for full content, 30 days for aggregated telemetry (non-identifiable). Customers may request shorter retention and can configure automatic deletion rules.
- Evidence & logs: Attached sample (training_optout_logs_sample.csv) includes fields: request_id, tenant_id_hash (hashed), optout_flag, ingestion_ts, deletion_ts, processed_by (service). Deletion events show timestamps and the job-run id.

If Legal wants a signed attestation, we can produce an opt-out confirmation letter on company letterhead — Karthik will attach that.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Security Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
